questions.comprehension_passage: Consider two investment opportunities in new products: gourmet marmite and gourmet honey. People might either really like or really dislike the gourmet marmite, so it generates a payoff of $0.5 with 30 percent probability, a payoff of $1 million with 40 percent probability and a payoff of $1.5 million with 30 percent probability.
